title: Generate side-by-side m3kit app port scaffold

target.description: Target component/page/route path to analyze when no analysis file is supplied.

domain.description: Domain name for generated libraries. Required unless supplied by analysis.

page.description: Page/feature name. Inferred from analysis or target when omitted.

analysis.description: Path to an analysis.json emitted by port-analyze.

mode.description: Generation mode. Scaffold is the default safe side-by-side mode.

destinationRoot.description: Root for generated libraries. Defaults to libs/<domain>.

scope.description: Alias prefix for lifted m3kit libs; auto-detected when omitted.

libs.description: Override m3kit libs. Defaults to analysis inferredM3kitLibs.

apply.description: Reserved for future route application. v1 emits snippets only and does not rewrite routes.

force.description: Overwrite generated destinations when explicit. Default refuses conflicts.
